Content settings control paragraph lines, list markers, emphasis, tables, and inline heading images

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"content\":{\"bullets\":\"*\",\"compact_tables\":true,\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_inline_images_in\":[\"h2\"],\"list_indent_width\":4,\"strip_newlines\":true,\"strong_em_symbol\":\"_\"}}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.markdown()?.content() as Any)
```
